tools.name: find_location
tools.title: Find a birthplace location
tools.description: Look up coordinates and UTC offset for a city, town, or district — covering every Indian state and union territory (all IST, UTC+05:30) plus major world cities. Accepts alternate/colonial spellings (e.g. Bombay → Mumbai). Returns the best matches for use with the moon and rise/set tools.

query.description: Place name to search, e.g. 'Madurai', 'Bombay', or 'Guwahati'.

tools.name: moon_phase
tools.title: Moon phase for a date
tools.description: Compute the real, astronomy-grade Moon phase for a given date and time (UTC). Returns phase name, illumination fraction, Moon age in days, waxing/waning, and the constellation the Moon is in. Uses VSOP87/ELP2000 ephemerides — never estimated.

datetime.description: ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, e.g. '1998-07-17T14:30:00Z'. A date-only value like '1998-07-17' is treated as UTC midnight.

tools.name: moon_sun_rise_set
tools.title: Moon & Sun rise/set times
tools.description: Compute accurate moonrise, moonset, sunrise, and sunset times for a specific calendar date at a given location. Times are returned as ISO 8601 UTC instants; provide the location's UTC offset so the correct civil day is used.

date.description: Calendar date 'YYYY-MM-DD' in the location's local civil time.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (north positive), e.g. 13.08 for Chennai.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (east positive), e.g. 80.27 for Chennai.

tzOffsetHours.description: UTC offset in hours for the location, e.g. 5.5 for India Standard Time. Defaults to 0 if omitted.

tools.name: next_moon_phase
tools.title: Next principal moon phase
tools.description: Find the next principal Moon phase (New Moon, First Quarter, Full Moon, or Last Quarter) after a given date-time. Returns the phase name and its exact UTC instant.

datetime.description: ISO 8601 date-time in UTC to search after, e.g. '2026-07-06T00:00:00Z'.
